about: Recorded first replies in the texting style the board asked for on HAL-10 (HAL-19588): one to three short lines, each its own chat message, reacting to what the message says. Every posted one must pass the check and go out line by line. Names and numbers are made up.

cases.name: example 1: a merge question: heard, then what gets checked
cases.title: Merge #6129
cases.reply:
Good question
Checking the queue for #6129

cases.name: example 2: a complaint about main: a human reaction, then what gets looked at
cases.title: Chat with Chief

earlier.author: Chief
earlier.body: Nightly issue for the failing area: HAL-18802.

cases.reply:
Ugh, again
Digging into the failing run, HAL-18802 has the area

cases.name: example 3: a request: acknowledged, then what is being looked at, not done
cases.title: Chat with Chief
cases.message: Put Leo's video on the 0.3 release card
cases.reply:
On it
Looking at Leo's video for the 0.3 release card

cases.name: example 4: a follow-up tied to the person's earlier message
cases.title: Chat with Chief
cases.reply:
Noted, docs too
Checking both for the 0.3 release notes

cases.name: example 5: a decision for the board: heard, with the current plan's task
cases.title: Chat with Chief
cases.message: Should we drop the Linux build for 0.3?
cases.reply:
Fair question
The current plan is HAL-18400

cases.name: an instruction: a single short acknowledgement is enough
cases.title: Chat with Chief
cases.message: I want the docs links fixed today

cases.name: a bug report: three short lines
cases.title: Chat with Chief

cases.reply:
Ah, annoying
On it
Looking into the docs links now
